messages:
anika: Quick sync: two teams shipped different rollout metadata shapes (compact ref vs verbose JSON). Need a single migration plan before we standardize.

rahul: Minimal examples? makes tradeoffs clearer.

anika: Compact: `{"ref":"h1:4b2c","bits":3}`. Verbose: `{"source":"registry/v2","cohort":"canary-11","fallbacks":["small-v1"],"expires":"2026-07-01T00:00:00Z","provenance":[{"commit":"f00d","by":"joel"}]}`

joel: I like storing verbose canonical records in CP for audits. But compact is better for per-request telemetry.

cass: Hybrid proposal: canonical immutable JSON stored under an anchor_hash (content-hash). CP returns anchor_hash + small anchor_snapshot for routing. Runtime carries anchor_hash and snapshot.

rahul: Important: make anchors immutable (content-hash) and link changes via prev_anchor. Mutable pointers are pain for audits.

anika: Agreed. Migration vector: add two non-breaking fields to rollout envelope: `anchor_hash` (string) and `anchor_snapshot` (optional object). Older components ignore them. New components use anchor_hash -> GET /anchors/{hash}.

joel: For Dedicated/private, CP lookups in hot-path are verboten. Runtimes need LRU cache + snapshot fallback. On cache miss, try CP with tight timeout (e.g., 30ms), else use snapshot.

cass: Add lifecycle in canonical JSON: `transient|standard|permanent` and a snapshot budget (<=256 bytes). Retention GC: transient 30d, standard 180d, permanent 10y. CP will export before deletion.

schema-bot: Reminder: schema changes require migration plan + rollback playbook. See /playbooks/schema-change-template.

anika: Staged rollout under feature flag: 1) CP emits anchor_hash in events. 2) CP responses include anchor_hash+snapshot; runtimes attach for telemetry. 3) Runtimes enable snapshot-based routing and caching.

rahul: Action items: anika draft migration appendix (field names + fallbacks), joel owns runtime cache design, cass owns retention/export, infra to spec anchor GET API with 50ms p95.

joel: One more nit: avoid the word "pin" in new fields to reduce confusion with older semantics.

anika: I'll PR the appendix tomorrow if no objections by EOD. :thumbsup:
